text:
Ravi P: Customer (NimbleHealth) requested an on-prem Private POC next week. They want a short preflight and clarity on POC billing if we need to fail over to Hosted.
Leah C: I can draft the preflight. Quick ask: which GPU SKUs?
Ravi P: 2x A100-40GB + 1x T4. Nodes are Ubuntu 22.04. Not air-gapped; egress allowed.
Leah C: Good. Minimal checks to ask them to paste: `nvidia-smi`, `uname -r`, `kubectl get nodes -o wide`, `containerd --version`. We'll require kubelet >=1.25 and containerd >=1.6.6.
DevEngBot: Generated checklist: https://internal.redwood/fe/check/1881234567 (driver, kernel, kubelet, containerd, ports).
OpsAssist: Network: outbound TCP 443 to control-plane, DNS to our domains, NTP. If installer needed, provide a bastion with limited IP allowlist; no broad SSH to workers.
SalesOps: POC billing: Hosted trial credits OR Dedicated trial rate. If Private POC must use Hosted fallback, hosted rates apply; Sales can approve a discretionary credit (up to $2k) for POC. Confirm with customer.
Ravi P: Action items: Leah 1 - send checklist + commands to customer; OpsAssist 1 - add network matrix; SalesOps 1 - confirm credit cap in proposal.
Leah C: I'll send now and request outputs before the preflight call. :thumbsup:
